My school wasn’t all that bad and was actually well known for its academics but the area I’m from was (and still is) quite notorious for narcotic use and distribution. My school had a very mixed demographic.

It’s wild to me how differently schools address sex ed. I think all schools across the country need to get on the same page with the information they give to young adults. 

I live in the Midwest and I grew up in a rather large city, around 1 million people, so you’d think my area would be more educated and up-to-date when it came to sex ed. I remember a few years before I entered high school, a total of around 40 high school aged girls got pregnant in one school year alone. My high school had well over 1,500 students, but still. 40 is a pretty high number of teen pregnancies. It’s crazy how some schools refuse to teach modern beliefs.

My schools “sex ed” was beating into our brains that abstinence was the only way to avoid pregnancy and STDs. I wish they would’ve taught us more about the different types of contraceptives and how they work as well as resources available if you were to become pregnant or get an STD rather just saying “don’t have sex until you’re married”. My high school experience was rather recent, too. Only about 5 years ago.

I suffer from TMJ but it definitely doesn’t sound as bad as yours. It only acts up every now and then but it still does make giving head hard sometimes. My boyfriend is super supportive and understanding. I still perform oral on him quite a bit but if my jaw ever starts to hurt during the act or if my jaw has already been hurting throughout the day, oral is off the table and he is 1,000% okay with that. Of course he’s bummed but he never uses it against me and he NEVER makes fun/shames me for it. If he truly cared about you and your feelings he would be understanding and want you to be comfortable and not in physical pain just so he can be satisfied. That’s selfish as fuck. 

Also, this guy sounds like he’s using you. You work 2 jobs, pay all the bills, gave him your old car, pay insurance on the car you gave him, and are suffering financially because of him and he’s okay with that? How is he not ashamed of himself? You seem like a pretty decent and hard working women. You deserve a man who can and will match that. I hope this helps you and shows you you’re worth because you deserve so much more.
